name: cdn-mcp-plugin
description: Operational know-how for uploading files to a personal CDN on Cloudflare R2 + Workers + D1. Installs the cdn-file-upload skill, which probes the sandbox's network egress each session and adapts: with egress it uploads zero-click via a signed R2 URL, direct PUT, and finalize; without it, it generates a clickable upload script that runs the local cdn CLI. Any file size or batch, never base64, with filename sanitization and post-upload verification either way. Requires a deployed cdn-mcp Worker — see the plugin README for setup.
